description: Latest reading and next-period outlook for a global freight index: drewry_wci (Drewry World Container Index, $/40ft container), baltic_dry_index (dry bulk shipping), tac_air_index (air cargo rates), or iata_jet_fuel (jet fuel price). Omit the index to get all four. A forecast band is shown only where it has passed a backtest and the source readings are consistent; otherwise the answer says what was held back and why. Does not count toward the allowance.

index.description: Which index. Omit or null for all four.

name: get_freight_index_outlook
title: Get an ocean or air freight index outlook
